forecasts.question: Will commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz reach >=30 vessels/day (7-day rolling average) before EOD 2026-10-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE (p=0.06→0.05). CENTCOM September 15 confirms El Gaia (Panama-flagged, Indian crew) was struck by an IRGC missile in a prior incident and then by an IRGC drone on September 12-13 while disabled off the Omani coast — active IRGC kinetic pressure on commercial vessels continues unabated (Republic World/Tribune India, Sep 15). Iran's September 9 attack wave — largest single-day shipping campaign of the war, targeting 10 ships near Hormuz plus a US base in Jordan; one seafarer killed on Hercules Star — confirms the PGSA toll regime is in active enforcement phase, not winding down. Windward/TankerMap: ~7 transits September 9 (10-day average ~13/day), below prior period's 14/day; no AIS data approached 30/day at any point since the MOU collapse. New vessel attack on a disabled tanker while at anchorage off Oman demonstrates IRGC willingness to enforce the toll boundary beyond the formal Strait chokepoint. With 17 days remaining to the October 3 horizon, reaching 30/day requires approximately 4x increase from current AIS levels; no structural precondition (toll suspension, insurance re-entry, mediator corridor arrangement) has materialized. Floor probability of 0.05.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Windward or TankerMap AIS data (authoritative primary sources; IMF PortWatch as secondary) records >=30 commercial transits/day as a 7-day rolling average at any point between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-03. forecasts.question: Will a confirmed Iran-US indirect negotiating session — defined as a face-to-face or formally convened indirect meeting (not mere message relay) between named US and Iranian senior officials via a named mediator — occur before EOD 2026-10-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE (p=0.18→0.20). Iranian FM Araghchi arrived in Beijing on September 16 for his fifth visit to China since 2024, meeting Foreign Minister Wang Yi in the first high-level Iran-China contact since the BRICS sideline exchange September 11-13, ahead of Chinese President Xi Jinping's scheduled visit to Washington on September 24 (ANI News, Sep 15; Tribune India, Sep 15). China purchases approximately 80% of Iran's shipped oil, making Beijing the most credible non-military lever over Tehran's economic calculus and the only currently active diplomatic channel between Iran and any major Western-aligned partner. A Xi-Trump summit discussion of the Iran war could yield a Chinese commitment to facilitate talks or apply economic pressure — a structural development not present when F8 was created. Against this: Araghchi reiterated the MOU-precondition posture on September 13 and no TIER1 source has reported Wang Yi proposing to mediate; Xi-Trump summits have not historically produced Iran-specific breakthrough commitments in the near term. Judge moved from 0.18 to 0.20: China channel is a real and newly activated diplomatic pathway but structural barriers (active kinetic exchange, Araghchi MOU precondition, no session infrastructure) keep probability below 0.25.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if at least one TIER1 source (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) reports a face-to-face or formally convened session between named US and Iranian senior officials via a named mediator (Oman, Qatar, Pakistan, Switzerland, or other named state), occurring between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15 inclusive.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: At least one TIER1 source naming both the US and Iranian official and identifying the mediator/venue, OR formal statement by the mediating government confirming a session occurred.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: RESOLVE-AMBIGUOUS if only anonymous-sourced reports with no named officials and no confirming mediator statement. Message-relay-only contact without physical or confirmed virtual session = NO. A preparatory or logistics meeting between mediator and only one side = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will CENTCOM publicly announce at least one confirmed kinetic strike against Iranian or IRGC targets between 2026-09-16 and EOD 2026-09-19?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 72-hour military forecast. Analyst initial p=0.52; DA recommended 0.30 citing Xi-Trump summit Sep 24 as operational-pause constraint (precedent: Trump paused operations July 27 before earlier Xi engagement); Judge selected 0.40. CENTCOM has not announced Iran-related strikes since the September 1-2 exchange, a 15-day operational quiet. Iran's September 9 attack wave (largest of war: 10 ships targeted, Brent >$100, 1 seafarer killed on Hercules Star, 1 missing) has received no confirmed CENTCOM kinetic response. CENTCOM's September 15 statement on El Gaia chose a press release over kinetics despite IRGC drone confirmation on a vessel with Indian casualties. Tailwinds for YES: 15-day gap after the largest Iranian attack of the war; El Gaia crew casualties create pressure on CENTCOM to respond; historical response gap ranges 1-14 days. Headwinds for NO: Xi-Trump Washington summit September 24 is a documented White House restraint signal; CENTCOM's rhetorical-rather-than-kinetic Sep 15 response was deliberate de-escalation choice; Araghchi in Beijing (not a US-accessible channel) limits diplomatic value of restraint in this specific window. Judge selects 0.40: above coin-flip given attack pattern but below Analyst estimate given summit calendar.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if US Central Command issues a press release, statement, or official DOD announcement confirming at least one kinetic strike against Iranian territory, IRGC vessels, IRGC-associated facilities, or named IRGC units between 2026-09-16 and EOD 2026-09-19. A CENTCOM press release or DOD spokesperson statement explicitly naming Iran or the IRGC as the target is required.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: CENTCOM official press release or DOD spokesperson statement, confirmed by at least one TIER1 source (Reuters/AP/AFP/Stars and Stripes). Social media announcements without official DOD confirmation do not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: CENTCOM strikes against Houthi targets in Yemen without IRGC attribution do not count. A classified or undisclosed operation not publicly confirmed by CENTCOM = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Counter-piracy operations without explicit IRGC attribution = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. CENTCOM strikes against Iran-backed proxy forces (Hezbollah, Kata'ib Hezbollah) in non-Iranian territory without direct IRGC attribution = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
